readback_body:
## Requirements: standalone Pages bounded evidence deep links

**Parent:** #1906 / #1782. Deliver practical hash-deep-link read-only Issue/PR evidence views from **already verified** standalone `pages/` source records. This must **not** pretend the missing #1664 implementing-PR/Slice publisher contract exists.

### Scope
- Support `#/work/issue/<number>` and `#/work/pr/<number>` for an Issue or PR **only if present in the bounded published snapshot**, plus back links; refresh/mobile render, invalid/unknown identifiers fail to explicit unavailable (not home or a false empty success).
- Issue view: canonical GitHub issue link, source timestamp, explicitly labeled GitHub Timeline cross-reference **mention, not implementation**, bounded previously validated Agent Run/Attempt identity with optional roles/target SHA/status and `PR linkage: Unlinked`, coverage warning for truncated/unavailable source.
- PR view: canonical PR link, exact observed HEAD, corresponding source-backed CI/E2E Run/Attempt and Review event at that HEAD only; **no overall approval or SC Pass**. Include sampled-workflow coverage and an **Unknown / Unlinked** Issue/Agent cause note. No joining on shared numbers, workflow names or Timeline mentions.
- No new backend, privileged client API, token, raw telemetry, orphan store writes, product `web/` design or components. Reuse existing versioned schema and allowlist; avoid any raw URL construction from untrusted snapshot fields.
- Deterministic negative/browser tests cover bad route identifiers, missing bounded snapshot members, XSS Issue text, exact HEAD, old approval not Pass, mobile direct reload and source link safety.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Direct, refresh-safe, bounded Issue/PR evidence routes use existing source-validated projection and reject malformed, unbounded and unknown identities fail-closed.
- [ ] SC-02 Partial evidence drilldown clearly separates independent Issue mention, Agent Run observation, exact HEAD Review/CI/E2E; never promotes Unlinked to proven ownership, stale Pass or orphan integrity.
- [ ] SC-03 Browser regression `pages-overview` and `pages-evidence` covers deep links, mobile/reload, malicious text and missing-source negative states; standalone `pages/` remains independent from product Web.
- [ ] SC-04 Exact PR HEAD Pages CI, Quality Gate, Case Smoke, selected E2E and canonical Agent Acceptance Pass.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr

```

- [x] No duplicate Writer/Controller/SC projector.
- [x] No causal claim without authenticated producer.
